name: Vaporwave
what_it_means: Vaporwave is an ironic, dreamy internet aesthetic built from 80s-90s consumer tech: Greek statues, pastel pink and teal, checkerboard floors, palm trees, Windows 95 windows, Japanese text and glitchy VHS effects. It feels nostalgic, surreal and slightly melancholic.
signature_moves: Retro OS windows, cursors, low-res graphics
Wide-spaced text ('Ａ Ｅ Ｓ Ｔ Ｈ Ｅ Ｔ Ｉ Ｃ') & Japanese → VHS noise, scanlines, glitch
best_for: Music & playlists, art projects, streetwear, meme savvy brands
prompt_template: B U I L D Y O U R U I R E P L A C E T H E [ B R A C K E T S ] ** Design a music/playlist page for [ARTIST] in a Vaporwave aesthetic. Pastel sunset gradient sky (pink #FF71CE to purple #B967FF), a perspective checkerboard floor, palm-tree silhouettes and a classical marble bust. Overlay a Windows-95-style window (grey bevelled title bar in #01CDFE) containing the track list and a retro media player. Headline in full-width spaced letters (' Ｖ Ａ Ｐ Ｏ Ｒ ') with Japanese katakana underneath. Use VT323 for UI text, add VHS scanlines, slight chromatic aberration and a pixel cursor.
